"Get Along" is a song written by Shane McAnally, Ross Copperman, and Josh Osborne and recorded by American country music artist Kenny Chesney.
It was released in April 2018 as the first single from Chesney's 2018 album Songs for the Saints.
It was also Chesney's first single to be released from Warner Bros.
Songs for the Saints is the eighteenth studio album by American country music singer Kenny Chesney.
It was released on July 27, 2018 via Warner Bros.
The album's content was inspired by Hurricane Irma.
